chapter.verse: Hih thu khit, Tiberias Tuili zong a kici, Galilee Tuili galkhat lamah Jesu paikhia hi.
Mihonpi in zong cinapa' tunga Jesu' bawl kihilna limte mu uh ahih manin Jesu zui uh hi.
Tua ciangin mualtung ah Jesu paito a, tua lai-ah a nungzuite tawh tukhawm hi.
Tu-in Jew mite' Paisan Pawi hun nai ta hi.
Jesu khuadak a, ama' lamah mihon tampi hong pai a muh ciangin Philip' kiangah, “Hih mite' nek ding anlum koi ah i lei ding hiam?” ci hi.
Jesu in ama' sep ding a thei pi mah, Philip a zia-etna-in hih thu a gen ahi hi.
Philip in, “Amaute khat ciat anlum themcik ta hawmsak ding hi lehang zong denarius zanih man nangawn kicing lo ding hi,” ci hi.
A nungzuite khat ahi Simon Peter' sanggampa Andrew in Jesu' kiangah,
“Hih takah mangbuhham anlum pum nga leh ngasa tawn nih a nei naupang khat om a, ahi zongin mi hizahtak' ading tua teng cih tham ding ahi hiam?” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Mite tusak un,” ci hi. (Tua mun ah lopa pha mahmah hi). Tua ahih manin mite zong tusuk uh a, tulnga kiim pha uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in anlumte la a, hehpihna a phat khit ciangin mi a tute' kiangah hawm hi. Tua mah bangin ngasa zong amau' deih zahzah hawmkhia hi.
Tua mite in zong a gilvah dong ne uh a, tua khit ciangin Jesu in a nungzuite' kiangah, “A maimang bangmah a om loh nadingin khamval anneng teng khawm un,” ci hi.
Nungzuite in zong anneng teng khawm uh a, mangbuhham anlum pum nga a ne mite' khamval pen anneng lawhbeu sawmlenih dim pha hi.
Mite in Jesu' bawl kihilna lim a muh uh ciangin, “Hih pen leitunga hong pai ding Kamsangpa a cih hi taktak hi,” ci uh hi.
Zawhthawh thu tawh kumpi mun ah amah a koih dingin mihonpi ama' kiangah hong pai ding uh cih Jesu in a theih ciangin amah guak mualtung lamah kihemkhia leuleu hi.
Nitak ciangin tuili ah Jesu' nungzuite paisuk uh a,
gunkuang khat sungah lutin tuili galkhat Capernaum lam zuan uh hi. Tu-in khuamui ta a, amau' kiangah Jesu tung nailo hi.
Huih khauhtak nung ahih manin tuihualte kilok hi.
Tai thum tai li kiim a hot khit uh ciangin tui tunga lampai, gunkuang gei lam hong naih Jesu mu uh a, amaute lau uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu in, “Keimah ka hi hi, lau kei un,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in gunkuang sungah Jesu lutsak nuam uh a,e tua lianleh gunkuang zong amau' manawhna leitang mun tung pah hi.

A zingciangin tuili galkhat lama a omlai mihonpi in tua mun ah gunkuang neu khat bek om ahihlam leh tua gunkuang tungah Jesu a nungzuite tawh kahkhawm lo-in a nungzuite bek amau guak paikhia ahihlam phawkkha uh hi.
Tiberias pan gunkuang dangte zong Topa in hehpih a phat khit-a mihonpi in anlum a nekna mun gei hong tung uh hi.
Mihonpi in tua mun ah Jesu ahi-a a nungzuite ahi zongin om lo cih a theih uh ciangin gunkuang neute tungah kah uh a, Jesu zong dingin Capernaum ah pai uh hi.
Tuili galkhat ah Jesu a muh uh ciangin amaute in, “Rabbi aw, bang hunin hih tak na tung na hi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Jesu in, “Maantak diktak kong cihin ah kei nong zon uh pen kihilna limte na muhkhak man uh hilo-in anlum gilvahtak na nekkhak man uh hizaw hi.

A siathei an ngah nading sangin note' tunga Mihing' Tapa' hong piak ding ahi, tawntung nuntakna dong a kimang an, na ngah nadingun nasem un. A hang pen Pa Pasian in Tapa' tungah ciaptehna gip belh khinzo hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, “Pasian' deih nasepte ka sep theih nadingun bang ka hih ding uh hiam?” ci uh hi.
Jesu in, “Pasian' hong sawlpa na up uh pen Pasian' deih nasep ahi hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, “Tua ahihleh mu-in kong up theih nadingun bang kihilna lim na bawl ding hiam? Bang na hih ding hiam?
‘Amaute' nek dingin vantung pan anlum a pia hi,’ ci-in a kigelh mah bangin ka pupite un gamgawtak lakah manna ne uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Jesu in, “Maantak diktak kong cihin ah vantung anlum hong pia pen Moses hilo a, vantung anlum taktak hong pia pen ka Pa hizaw hi.
A hang pen Pasian' anlum cih ciangin vantung panin a hong pai, leitung mite' tungah nuntakna a piapa ahi hi,” ci hi.
Amaute in, “Sya aw, tua anlum ko hong pia tawntung in,” ci uh hi.
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Kei pen nuntakna anlum ka hi hi. Kei hong zuan peuhpeuh gilkial ngeilo ding a, kei hong um peuhpeuh dangtak ngeilo ding hi.
Ahi zongin kong cih ngei khat ah note in kei hong mu napi nong um kei uh hi.
Ka pa' hong piak khempeuh kei' kiangah hong pai ding uh a, kei' kiangah hong pai peuhpeuh ka nawlkhin ngeikei ding hi.
A hang pen keima' deih thu a sem ding hilo-in kei hong sawlpa' deih thu a sem dingin vantung pan kong paisuk hi.
Tua hi a, ama' hong piak khempeuh khat beek mansuah lo-in ni tawpni ciangin thokiksak ding cih pen kei hong sawlpa' deih thu ahi hi.
A hang pen Tapa mu-in a um khempeuh tawntung nuntakna a neih ding ka Pa' deih thu hi a, ni tawpni ciangin amaute ka thokiksak ding hi.”
Jesuh' thugen, “Vantung pan hong pai anlum ka hi hi,” a cihna hangin Jew mite phun uh a,
“Hih mipa, a pa leh a nu zong i theih, Joseph' tapa Jesu hilo ahi hiam? Tua kimlai bang hangin ‘Vantung pan kong pai hi,’ ci thei ahi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Jesu in amaute hih bangin dawng hi: “Note khatlekhat kihuau khuankhuan kei un.
Kei hong sawlpa Pa in a kaih lohin kei' kiangah kuamah hong pai theilo ding hi. Hong paite ni tawpni ciangin ka thokiksak ding hi.
Kamsang Laibu sungah, ‘Amaute khempeuh Pasian in hilh ding hi,’ ci-in kigelh hi. Pa' kiangpan thu za-in a sin peuhmah kei' kiangah hong tung hi.
(Hih pen Pa a mu ngei mi om cihna hilo hi—Pasian' kiangpan hong paipa bek in Pa mu ngei hi.)
Maantak diktak kong cihin ah a um peuhpeuh in tawntung nuntakna nei hi.
Kei pen nuntakna anlum ka hi hi.
Na pupite un gamgawtak lakah manna ne uh a, si veve uh hi.
Hih takah vantung pana hong pai anlum om a, tua a ne mite si lo ding uh hi.
Kei pen vantung pana hong pai a nungta anlum ka hi hi. Hih anlum a ne peuhmah a tawntungin nungta ding hi. Leitung mite' nuntak nadinga ka piak ding anlum pen keima' cilesa ahi hi.”
Tua ciangin Jew mite amau teng mah kisel uh a, “Hih mipa in nek dingin a sa hong bangci piak theih ding hiam?” ci uh hi.
Tua hangin Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Maantak diktak kong cihin ah Mihing' Tapa' sa ne lo-in ama' si na dawn kei uhleh nomau' sungah nuntakna om lo hi.
Ka sa tawh kivakin ka si a dawn peuhpeuh tawntung nuntakna a nei hi a, ni tawpni ciangin amah ka thokiksak ding hi.
A hang pen ka sa, an taktak hi a, ka si, tui taktak ahi hi.
Ka sa ne-in ka si a dawn peuhpeuh keima' sungah a omkip hi a, kei zong ama' sungah ka omkip hi.
A nungta Pa' sawlpa ka hih mah bangin leh Pa' hangin a nungta ka hih mah bangin kei tawh a kivak peuhpeuh keima' hangin nungta ding hi.
Hih pen vantung pana hong pai anlum hi a, ne napi a kisi veve ahi pupite' anlum tawh kibang lo hi. Hih anlum tawh a kivak peuhmah a tawntungin nungta ding hi.”
Hih thute pen Jesu in Capernaum ah a thuhilh sungin vengkhawm inn ah a gen ahi hi.
Ama' nungzuite tampitak in Jesu' thugen a zak uh ciangin, “Hih pen thu haksapi khat hi. Kua'n tel zo ding ahi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu in hih vai-in ama' nungzuite phun uh cih a sungpan thei ahih manin amaute' kiangah hih bangin gen hi: “Hih thu hangin lungnuammawh na hi uh hiam?
Tua ahihleh Mihing' Tapa a omnasa mun ah a kahtoh mu hileh uhcin bang na ci ding uh hiam?
Nuntakna hong pia pen Kha hi a, cilesa' cihpih theih bangmah om lo hi. Note' kianga kong gen thute pen kha thu leh nuntakna thu ahi hi.
Ahih hangin no teng lakah a um lo kimkhat na om uh hi.” (Hih bang a genna pen a patcil pan Jesu in a um lo kua teng hi-a amah a lehhek ding kua cih thei khin ahih man hi).
Tua ciangin genbeh lai a, “Pa' phal lohin ka kiangah kuamah hong pai theilo kong cih pen hih thu hang ahi hi,” ci hi.
Tua khit, ama' nungzuite tampitak kilehkik uh a, Jesu kithuahpih nawnlo uh hi.
Tua hangin Jesu in sawmlenihte' kiangah, “No zong na paikhia nuam mai uh hiam?” ci hi.
Simon Peter in, “Topa aw, kua' kiangah pai ding ka hi uh hiam? Nangmah in tawntung nuntakna thu na nei hi.
Kote in zong kong um uh a, nang pen Pasian' Mi Siangtho na hihlam kong thei khin uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Jesu in, “Note na sawmlenih mahun keima' kong tenkhiat hilo ahi hiam? Hinapi note' lakah khat dawimangpa a nahi mawk hi,” ci hi.
Simon Iscariot ii tapa Judas' thu a gen hi a, a hang pen sawmlenihte laka kihel Judas in Jesu lehhek ding ahih man hi.
